annotations.title: Check whether domain names are registered

description: Check up to 25 domain names live against DNS and the registries' own RDAP records and say which are registered and which look available to register, with registration and expiry dates for lists of five or fewer. Pass alternativesFor with one name or label to check it across .com, .net, .org, .io, .ai, .co, .app, .dev and .xyz. Use it before suggesting any name as available: an answer from memory is often wrong. Use inspect_domain instead for the full public record of one name, and appraise_domain for what a name is worth. Status is unregistered (the registry has no record), likely_unregistered (no DNS and no RDAP for that suffix), registered or unknown; a registry can still reserve or premium-price a name that looks available. Read-only, free, no key; makes one or two DNS and RDAP requests per uncached name, runs no valuation.

alternativesFor.description: One name or bare label, such as brightpath or brightpath.com, to check across nine popular suffixes. Combined with domains, the total is capped at 25.

domains.description: Full domain names to check, up to 25, such as brightpath.com. Pasted URLs are accepted; duplicates are checked once.

name: check_domain_availability

acquireUrl.description: Present on a short list whose wanted name is taken and not listed: a request for audit.domains to approach the owner (fee only if bought).

availableCount.description: Names whose status is unregistered or likely_unregistered.

budget.description: This request's uncached-lookup budget: lane (free or keyed), used, limit, remaining, and keyRejected when a key was sent and refused. Cached names cost nothing.

citeAs.description: A structured citation. Quote `text` or build your own from the fields. Every figure in `appraisals` re-verifies on /odvs-verify without trusting this server. Tools whose answer is not an appraisal (a bracket, which withholds estimates by contract, and the recorded-sales tools, whose rows are not hashed) return an empty `appraisals`.

items.description: One appraisal holding exactly the fields its ODVS hashes commit to. Paste it into https://audit.domains/odvs-verify/ to recompute all three hashes client-side. appraisalHash is the appraisal's identity; resultDigest checks the output only.

confidence.description: Internal 0-100 model score, NOT a probability.

methodologyVersion.description: The methodology revision hashed into this record (as rev-<value>, or rev-n/a when null). It, not citeAs.revision, produced the figure.

edition.description: ODVS edition id; null until editions are published.

revision.description: The methodology revision live on the server at retrieval. A record's own methodologyVersion is what produced its figure and can differ.

forSaleCount.description: Taken names whose owner sells them (a live checkout here or the owner's own _for-sale DNS record); each carries forSale.

invalid.description: Inputs that are not domain names; nothing was looked up for them.

limit.description: Present with pending: code lookup_limit, retryable, retryAfterSeconds, and retry ({tool, arguments}: send it unchanged after that wait to continue exactly where this call stopped). Where a key lifts the limit, upgrade says how.

pending.description: Names not checked because the lookup limit was reached. limit.retry is the call that checks them.

forSale.description: Present when the owner sells this taken name: askingPrice (indicative), buyUrl when checkout is live here, listedHere.

title: Check whether domain names are registered
